cases.name: Login establishes an admin session
cases.expectation: login succeeds and the S09 settings panel renders
observations: dashboard shell and S09 panel rendered

cases.name: S09 page is available
cases.expectation: /dashboard/settings/auth-rbac renders 认证与 RBAC 设置 with the settings.auth-rbac.v1 descriptor

cases.name: Fresh fixture shows compiled defaults
cases.expectation: effective policy shows 12 / 30 / 10080 minutes with compiled_default projection and no publications

cases.name: Read-only actor sees no write controls
cases.expectation: read-only profile renders no 创建草稿 control and no publish capability
observations: read-only write actions denied=True; no enabled create/publish controls

cases.name: Create a structurally valid draft succeeds
cases.expectation: a draft with sessionLifetimeMinutes 60 is accepted and listed

cases.name: Out-of-range value is rejected with a field error
cases.expectation: minimumLength 8 shows a field error and no draft is created
observations: field error shown=True; no extra draft created (count=1)

cases.name: Validate the draft as validated
cases.expectation: validate reports 验证通过 with no blockers

cases.name: Safe diff shows the exact public value change
cases.expectation: diff lists sessionPolicy.sessionLifetimeMinutes 10080 -> 60 with public sensitivity and zero secrets

cases.name: Publish executes and returns a generation
cases.expectation: publish succeeds with a positive generation and readiness reports the published generation

cases.name: Published policy is effective and consumer-ready
cases.expectation: overview shows projectionState published with sessionLifetimeMinutes 60 and readiness consumerGeneration equals publishedGeneration
observations: overview published=published effective session TTL=60; readiness=ready

cases.name: History is append-only with original publication facts
cases.expectation: published entries keep their original auditEventId

cases.name: Rollback creates a new draft from the current publication
cases.expectation: rollback-draft returns a rollback_draft with rollbackOfPublicationId set

cases.name: Rollback publish restores the previous S09 value
cases.expectation: publishing the rollback draft yields a generation above the superseded one and overview shows the restored value
observations: rollback generation=2 (>0); effective restored session TTL=60

cases.name: Stale version yields VERSION_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: a stale expectedVersion yields a controlled 409 VERSION_CONFLICT
observations: stale version validate refused with 409 VERSION_CONFLICT

cases.name: Illegal state yields SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT
cases.expectation: publishing an unvalidated draft yields a controlled 409 SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT
observations: publish of unvalidated draft refused with 409 SETTINGS_STATE_CONFLICT

cases.name: Malformed UUID yields a controlled 400
cases.expectation: a non-UUID draft id returns a stable 400, never a 500
observations: malformed UUID status 400; valid missing UUID status 404

cases.name: Impact preview allows a non-blocking change
cases.expectation: nextStatus active for the last super admin returns wouldBlockLastSuperAdmin false with safeReasonCode allowed

cases.name: Impact preview blocks suspending the last super admin
cases.expectation: nextStatus suspended with superAdminCount 1 returns wouldBlockLastSuperAdmin true with LAST_SUPER_ADMIN_BLOCKED

cases.name: Impact preview requires a change and validates the target
cases.expectation: no change or malformed target yields a controlled 400

cases.name: Session revoke requires the exact confirmation
cases.expectation: a wrong confirmation yields AUTH_RBAC_CONFIRMATION_INVALID and nothing is revoked

cases.name: Session revoke succeeds with confirmation and reason
cases.expectation: REVOKE_SESSIONS + reason revokes the target sessions and reports revokedCount

cases.name: Audit safe snapshot carries real roles and no value fields
cases.expectation: mutation Audit rows carry effectiveRoles/grants and metadata only with descriptorKey; revoke rows carry only targetUserId/reasonCode
observations: audit roles=['super_admin'] grants=['settings.read', 'settings.write', 'sessions.revoke']; metadata={"descriptorKey": "settings.auth-rbac"}; revoke metadata safe=True

cases.name: Logout and post-logout state are clean
cases.expectation: logout returns to login and no protected settings state remains
